mentions.name: Plask
mentions.description: A Google Analytics (GA4)-connected analytics dashboard that consolidates all of a user's GA4 properties into a single overview, runs statistical anomaly detection, sends alerts when something breaks, and generates AI weekly digests. Free tier covers 2 properties; Pro is $9/mo.
mentions.problem: Manually checking separate GA4 properties across multiple apps and SaaS projects is tedious, and setting up individual MCP integrations for each is overkill when all that's needed is a quick overview.
mentions.audience: People who ship multiple products with several apps and SaaS projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: Plask ( https://plask.dev ) — Google Analytics (GA4) connected analytics dashboard for people who ship multiple products. I got tired of manually checking separate GA4 properties for all my apps and SaaS projects, and setting up individual MCP integrations for each felt like overkill when I just wanted a quick overview. So I built a single dashboard that connects all your GA4 properties, runs statistical anomaly detection, sends alerts when something breaks, and generates AI weekly digests. Free tier for 2 properties, Pro at $9/mo.
